steps.title: Open Docker Desktop
steps.why: Docker provides the container runtime for every NanoClaw agent. It must be running before the next two steps will work.

steps.title: Start OneCLI
steps.why: OneCLI is the credential gateway. Without it, agent containers spawn but get HTTP 401 from Anthropic.

steps.title: Restart NanoClaw
steps.why: Reloads the orchestrator so it picks up Docker + OneCLI being available.

steps.title: Verify the dashboard is reachable
steps.why: Confirms NanoClaw's HTTP server is bound and serving /health.
